name: CNS samplers
plain: Euler or ER-SDE where the re-noise term is shaped by a frequency gain table (gamma matrix) per step. Uses FFT with radial bins; the patch pack uses Haar wavelet bands instead. Different packs implement this for different model families.
math:
Euler CNS: x+=d(σ′−σ). σ↑=σ′√(1−(σ′/σ)²)·s_churn. scale=compute_noise_scaling(γ[step],power,divider,α_tilt). n_c=apply_cns_to_noise(randn,scale,bins). x+=n_c·σ↑.
ER-SDE CNS: core er_sde with a recolorer loaded by model family.
Patch: wraps any KSAMPLER noise_sampler.

providers.author: sorryhyun
providers.note: ER-SDE base; gamma family by model; has MOSS and anima branches

providers.author: namemechan
providers.note: Wraps other samplers by signature inspection and monkeypatching kdiffusion attrs

label: from code
surprise: Euler CNS adds noise σ↑ on top of a full step to σ′ without lowering the target, so variance at σ′ rises.

audit.note: No DCT in any CNS code read. IIs-fanta nodes.py:225 and Spectrum _vendor/.../cns_core.py:153 use fft2 with radial bins; the namemechan patch uses Haar bands. dct exists in that pack only in spd.py, a different feature.
